body: EVAL HARNESS: degenerate n=1 truncated samples (gold). scripts/score_gold_anchor.py feeds the binary sample_values_truncated from columns.parquet; SOME columns have n=1 (a single stored value). Consequences proven 2026-06-17 (output/categorical-alnum-recall/finding_studies.md): (a) the model classifies a 1-value 'column' unreliably -> pessimistic FN (e.g. 'Type' predicted word in harness but IS categorical on full data) -> the gold baseline 0.789 understates production accuracy on low-sample columns; (b) full-column-statistic studies are INVALID on this harness (baseline preds and stats from different value sets). FIX: have predict read a proper sample (or the full column) from the source file for columns whose stored truncated sample is below a floor (e.g. n<20), OR regenerate columns.parquet with a larger sample cap. Quantify how many of the 931 gold columns have n<20 stored samples and how the headline moves once they get proper samples. Belongs to card 0002/0019 (gold corpus) as its own spec.

SPUN OUT to durable substrate (memory full-column-stat-sharpen-is-redundant + finding_studies.md). Belongs to card 0002/0019 as its own future spec; closing here so this spec closes cleanly. Not lost.
